title: Mixer
text: Model RF and IQ modulator and RF and IQ demodulator with impairments and noise, 1 input, 1 output, {Mixer type} sets Type of mixer; {Sideband}, {RF (Hz)} sets the rF carrier frequency 1e9, {LO (Hz)} sets the local oscillator frequency 1e8, {Gain (dB)} sets the conversion gain for mixer, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {LO phase offset (deg)}, {I/Q gain imbalance (dB)} sets the iQ gain imbalance, {I/Q phase imbalance (deg)} sets the iQ phase imbalance, {Non-Linearity} sets the third-order nonlinearity type, {IIP3 (dBm)} sets the input third-order intercept, {OIP3 (dBm)} sets the output third-order intercept, {IP1dB (dBm)} sets the input 1 dB compression, {OP1dB (dBm)} sets the output 1 dB compression, {IPsat (dBm)} sets the input saturation point, {OPsat (dBm)} sets the output saturation point, {Plot power characteristics}, {Include mixer noise} adds mixer noise to system, {Mixer noise type} sets the noise representation, {Noise temperature (K)} sets the noise temperature to model mixer noise, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the noise figure to model mixer noise 10 *, {Noise factor}, {Seed source, mixer noise} sets the source of initial seed, {Seed for mixer noise} sets the seed for random number generator, {Include phase noise} adds LO phase noise to LO signal, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise level relative to carrier, {Frequency offset (Hz)} sets the phase frequency offset, {Automatic frequency resolution} sets the automatically determine number of frequency, {Number of signal samples} sets the number of samples in time-domain signal, {Seed source, phase noise} sets the source of initial seed, {Seed for phase noise} sets the seed for random number generator and {Plot phase characteristics}. Values come from the instance.
